g.text: Title: MOSFETAmp2 stereo amplifier - experimental Rev 0.1

g.desc: Title: MOSFETAmp2 stereo amplifier - experimental Rev 0.1

g.text: 1. Fit bias short J101/J201; set trimmers for MAXIMUM resistance.

g.desc: 1. Fit bias short J101/J201; set trimmers for MAXIMUM resistance.

g.text: 2. Verify live tab insulation and Q108/Q208 thermal contact.

g.desc: 2. Verify live tab insulation and Q108/Q208 thermal contact.

g.text: 3. Connect supply GND to the junction of the two series bench outputs.

g.desc: 3. Connect supply GND to the junction of the two series bench outputs.

g.text: 4. Connect oscilloscope earth clips to board GND only.

g.desc: 4. Connect oscilloscope earth clips to board GND only.

g.text: 5. Use dummy loads; no speakers until DC protection and warm-up tests pass.

g.desc: 5. Use dummy loads; no speakers until DC protection and warm-up tests pass.

g.text: External PSU assumption envelope: roughly +/-13.4 V valley to +/-20.5 V peak.

g.desc: External PSU assumption envelope: roughly +/-13.4 V valley to +/-20.5 V peak.

g.text: Final transformer and capacitors not fixed. Recalculate and measure before use.

g.desc: Final transformer and capacitors not fixed. Recalculate and measure before use.

g.text: Schematic connected and ERC checked separately from electrical/model/thermal validation.

g.desc: Schematic connected and ERC checked separately from electrical/model/thermal validation.

g.text: The original empty PCB is retained. Layout is for the user; no routing supplied.

g.desc: The original empty PCB is retained. Layout is for the user; no routing supplied.

g.text: REV 0.1: SIMULATION DEVELOPMENT / NOT FABRICATION RELEASED

g.desc: REV 0.1: SIMULATION DEVELOPMENT / NOT FABRICATION RELEASED

g.text: 8 ohm prototype; external current-limited +/-12 to +/-15 V first.

g.desc: 8 ohm prototype; external current-limited +/-12 to +/-15 V first.

g.text: No mains circuitry. External DC speaker protection required. Read README and bench procedure.
